credits.overview: As the Lino Vartan shelter, which takes orphans and seniors in, has to shut down for health issues, Milann has no choice but to accept the invitation of a retirement home in the south of France.

credits.title: The Lost Patient
credits.overview: The 19 years old Thomas wakes up in a hospital after three years in a coma. He doesn't remember anything. The psychologist Anna tells him that his family has been murdered and that he is the only survivor of the massacre while his sister Laura is still missing.

credits.title: Clostrophobia
credits.overview: Peter takes the elevator to meet his mom at her work. Suddenly, the elevator stops and won't open. The little boy plunges into a terrible moment of anxiety and hallucination. He tries in vain to find a way out, in an increasingly fearful atmosphere.
